n4526b8868d.headline: Market: Slump in first quarter, acceleration expected in second quarter
n4526b8868d.summary: Chinese economic growth probably slowed in the first quarter to its lowest level in 27 years, with acceleration expected in the second quarter.
n4526b8868d.why: China is the world's second-largest economy, and its growth rates significantly influence global markets and commodity demand.
n4526b8868d.why_moved: The slowdown to a 27-year low in China's growth raised concerns about global economic momentum, affecting markets and commodities.
